title: Business Support Officer - Local Authority Library
description:
Business Support Officer
- Location: Sheffield City Centre
- Salary: £13.45 per hour
- Job Type: Interim, Full-time

We are seeking a Business Support Officer for a two-month assignment in a library environment. This role is ideal for someone with experience using the Sheffield City Council Integra finance system to process orders and journals, alongside general administration skills.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Perform general administrative duties including invoicing, photocopying, and shredding.
- Produce simple posters for libraries and manage stationery orders and stock.
- Sort and distribute post at the Central Library and handle new book processing.
- Manage telephone and email enquiries, assist in opening and closing the Central Library.
- Provide reception cover and distribute books to various libraries.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience with Sheffield City Council Integra finance system.
- Customer-focused with the ability to meet the needs of internal and external customers and respond to customers to required standards.
- Proven ability to work effectively in a team and maintain productive working relationships.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Working knowledge of relevant office software packages.
- Experience supporting financial transactions, monitoring, and reconciling financial activities.
- Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
- Minimum Level 2 qualification according to National Qualifications Framework (e.g., 5 GCSEs grades A - C including Maths and English, NVQ2, BTEC, First Diplomas and Certificates) or equivalent qualifications or experience.

Benefits:
- Gain valuable experience in a supportive public service environment.
- Work in a role that offers varied tasks and the opportunity to contribute to community services.

To apply for this Business Support Officer position, please submit your CV by clicking Apply Now.

title: Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant
description:
Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant

On-site Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant - Sheffield

Role: Credit Controller & Accounts AssistantLocation: SheffieldPackage: £28k to £30kHours / pattern: On siteConsultant: Connie

All applications are handled in confidence by Shillito Group.

Overview

Shillito Group is seeking an organised Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant to join its Sheffield team on site. The role combines customer credit control with day-to-day accounts assistance, supporting invoicing, payment allocation and month-end tasks. You will work closely with the finance team to maintain accurate accounts, reduce overdue debt and ensure timely reconciliation.

Key responsibilities
- Manage customer accounts and proactively chase overdue invoices to reduce days sales outstanding.
- Prepare and issue invoices, credit notes and customer statements accurately and promptly.
- Allocate customer receipts and reconcile bank transactions and ledgers.
- Support month-end close with account reconciliations and assisting with journal entries.
- Maintain accurate credit records, assess customer credit risk and raise queries where needed.

What we are looking for
- Previous experience in credit control and general accounts administration.
- Excellent numeracy, attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident use of accounting software and spreadsheets.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills with customers and internal teams.
- AAT or equivalent accounting qualification desirable or working towards one.

Package and benefits

£28k to £30k

Next step
- Submit CV to the Shillito Group consultant for initial review.
- Telephone screening with the recruiter to discuss suitability and availability.
- Interview.

Shillito Group is a specialist recruitment and executive search partner, working with ambitious businesses to secure high-impact talent across commercial and engineering markets. Our reputation is built on deep expertise, trusted relationships and delivering results that go beyond the brief.

title: Recruitment Resourcer / Administrator
company: Lynx Employment Services Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Location: Sheffield (Office Based) Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday Contract: Temporary 3 months (with potential to be extended) Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Lynx Employment Services has been connecting great people with great employers since 2001. Due to increased demand, we're looking for a Temporary Recruitment Resourcer / Administrator to join our friendly, busy team in Sheffield.

This is a varied role where no two days are the same. You'll support our recruitment consultants by sourcing candidates, managing compliance, speaking to applicants and clients, and ensuring vacancies are filled quickly and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Sourcing and screening candidates for temporary and permanent vacancies.
- Advertising jobs across multiple job boards and social media platforms.
- Conducting telephone interviews and candidate registrations.
- Arranging interviews and booking candidates into assignments.
- Processing references, right to work checks and DBS applications.
- Maintaining accurate records on our recruitment database.
- Liaising with clients and candidates throughout the recruitment process.
- Providing general administration support to the recruitment team.
- Assisting with compliance documentation and onboarding.

About You

We're looking for someone who:

Has previous recruitment, resourcing or administration experience (preferred but not essential). Is confident speaking to people on the telephone. Has excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Can work at pace and manage multiple tasks. Has good IT skills, including Microsoft Office. Is proactive, positive and enjoys working as part of a team. Delivers excellent customer service and communicates professionally.

What We Offer

A supportive and friendly working environment. Full training on our systems and processes. The opportunity to gain valuable recruitment experience across a range of sectors including engineering, manufacturing, public sector, legal and business support. Potential for the assignment to be extended for the right person.

If you're organised, enjoy working with people and want to join a well-established recruitment business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Regeneration and Property Service Support Help Desk Officer
description:
Service Support & Help Desk Officer
- Location: Hybrid (Sheffield Centre + Remote)
- Contract: Interim
- Hours: 37 hours per week, Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm (Flexible)
- Pay: £13.69 per hour PAYE

Join our client in their City Futures team as a Service Support & Help Desk Officer. This role is ideal for someone proactive and detail-oriented, ready to act as the first point of contact for property-related enquiries, supporting the management of commercial estates and surplus assets.

Day-to-day of the role:

- Triage and assess requests, extracting key information.
- Log, track, and allocate enquiries to the appropriate teams.
- Maintain accurate records across internal systems.
- Support the reduction of enquiry backlogs.
- Provide general coordination and administrative support.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Strong organisational and coordination skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage and prioritise a high volume of enquiries.
- Confident using IT systems and databases.
- Strong communication skills.

Desirable:
- Experience in a help desk, service desk, or coordination role.
- Background in property, estates, or facilities management.

Benefits:
- Hybrid working model with a minimum of 1 day per week in the Sheffield office.
- Option for additional office-based working if preferred.
- Full training and support provided.
- Opportunity to join a well-established, income-generating service.
- Strong development potential within the team.
- Possibility of contract extension or permanent opportunities.

To apply for the Service Support & Help Desk Officer position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
company: B. Braun Medical Limited - Company - Permanent
description:
Company description:

B. Braun Melsungen AG

Job description:

As Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you will be at the heart of the recruitment and onboarding journey. You will coordinate day-to-day activity from interview through to start date, working closely with candidates, new starters, hiring managers, People Services, Talent Acquisition colleagues and wider stakeholders.You will help keep activity moving, provide clear and timely updates, track key actions, identify risks or delays early, and ensure recruitment and onboarding administration is completed accurately and in line with our policies, compliance requirements and values.

Key Details:
- Location: Thorncliffe Park, Sheffield, S35 2 PW.
- Hybrid working: Minimum three days per week onsite, with flexibility to work from home for part of the week.
- Contract: Permanent, 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

What you will be doing:
- Act as a key contact for candidates, new starters and hiring managers during recruitment and onboarding.
- Coordinate interviews, offers, contracts, employment checks and starter documentation.
- Maintain accurate recruitment records and help ensure key actions are completed on time.
- Provide clear, timely updates so stakeholders understand what is happening and what comes next.
- Identify delays, risks or gaps early and escalate appropriately.
- Support recruitment campaigns, early careers activity and improvements to the candidate experience.

About youYou might already have experience in HR, recruitment or onboarding, or you may bring transferable skills from a busy administration, coordination or customer service environment.What matters most is your ability to stay organised, communicate clearly and create a positive experience for others. You will enjoy supporting people, taking ownership of tasks, keeping stakeholders informed and finding practical ways to improve how things work.

We are looking for someone who
- Communicates with warmth, clarity and professionalism.
- Has strong attention to detail and follows through on actions.
- Can manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
- Builds trust through reliable updates and a helpful approach.
- Takes a considered, solution-focused approach when priorities change.
- Is curious, improvement-minded and willing to suggest better ways of working.
- Is confident using Microsoft Office and willing to learn new systems.
- Cares about fairness, accessibility and inclusion in recruitment.

What we offerAt B. Braun, you will be part of a supportive team where your contribution matters. We offer the opportunity to build your experience in Talent Acquisition, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and play a meaningful part in helping people begin their journey with us.

Career Development
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities
- Long-term career opportunities within a global healthcare organisation
- Paid professional membership (where required)
- Opportunities to learn from experienced healthcare and industry professionals

Reward & Benefits
- Discretionary annual bonus scheme
- 7% employer pension contribution
- Life assurance at 3x salary
- Health Cash Plan
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Group income protection scheme

Wellbeing & Lifestyle
- 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Enhanced family-friendly and sick pay benefits
- Gym membership discounts
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Everyday Discounts and Blue Light Card savings

And much more.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Join a market-leading healthcare organisation where your expertise helps support healthcare professionals and improve patient care across the UK.

Apply today and become part of Team B. Braun.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At B. Braun, we believe that diversity drives innovation and excellence. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to be themselves.

We want every candidate to have a positive recruitment experience. If you need support during the hiring process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best. Reasonable adjustments may include additional time for assessments, accessible interview arrangements or alternative interview formats.

Our Talent Acquisition Specialists are happy to discuss any support you may need throughout the recruitment process.
